ideas.question: How do maternal health problems before pregnancy recorded in PRAMS Phase 8 (prams_p8_arf) relate to SUID incidence among infants as captured by the CDC linked birth/infant death public-use file guide (cdc_linkco15)?
ideas.why_open: While existing studies have explored specific factors like smoking and prematurity, no research has comprehensively evaluated a broad array of pre-pregnancy health problems in relation to SUID. The combined dataset would provide a more comprehensive picture.

ideas.question: What is the impact of maternal socioeconomic status, as detailed in PRAMS Phase 8 (prams_p7_arf), on SUID risk factors and incidence among infants born to those mothers, according to the CDC linked birth/infant death file guide (cdc_linkco15)?
ideas.why_open: The interplay between socioeconomic status and SUID has not been extensively studied in detail, and this would allow a deeper understanding of how economic pressures might contribute to risk factors.
ideas.data: Income and Dependent Information (prams_p7_arf); Birth Details 2 (cdc_linkco15)

ideas.question: How does the frequency of multivitamin use during pregnancy, as recorded in PRAMS Phase 8 (prams_p8_std2), correlate with SUID incidence among infants in the CDC natality public-use file guide (cdc_natl15)?
ideas.why_open: Previous research has not extensively examined the role of maternal vitamin intake in relation to SUID risk, which could provide insights into potential protective factors.

ideas.question: What are the effects of breastfeeding practices during the postpartum period, as documented in PRAMS Phase 7 (prams_p7_arf), on SUID incidence among infants recorded in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (ncfrp_v51)?
ideas.why_open: While there is some data on breastfeeding and infant health, a more detailed analysis of postpartum practices could shed light on potential protective or risk factors for SUID.
ideas.data: Breastfeeding Status (prams_p7_arf); Infant Sleep Environment and Disposition Details (ncfrp_v51)

ideas.question: How does the presence of a crib or similar sleeping arrangement, as recorded in the National Fatality Review Case Reporting System (ncfrp_v51), impact SUID incidence among infants whose mothers reported on their postpartum care and breastfeeding practices in PRAMS Phase 8 (prams_p8_arf)?
ideas.why_open: While many studies have focused on sleep environment as a risk factor, combining these datasets could provide deeper insights into how specific arrangements correlate with SUID.
ideas.data: Infant Sleep Environment (ncfrp_v51); Breastfeeding Information Sources and Practices (prams_p8_arf)
